### Implied meaning

### Antonym
- [[Sen'fi/Glossary/Spatial concepts/in\|in]]
### Etymology
#### Glyph
- ideograph of an arrow (half an arrow head) exiting something; compare this to [[Sen'fi/Glossary/Spatial concepts/in\|in]].
- Similar to oracle bone script 出 (which shows a foot coming out of a hollow object).
#### Sound
- *a priori:* on=largeness (that is outside something)
